mistakes: Arching the lower back at the top instead of squeezing the glutes
Pushing through the toes, which shifts work to the thighs
Letting the knees fall in or out
bridge.easier: Lift halfway and hold 2 seconds; keep both feet closer to the hips.
bridge.harder: Single-leg bridge, or rest your upper back on a bench (hip thrust).
bridge.care: Low-back pain that grows during the lift: make the range smaller and tuck the pelvis first.

mistakes: Front heel lifting off the floor
Feet in one line, like a tightrope, so balance fails
split_squat.easier: Hold a wall or chair and lower only halfway.
split_squat.harder: Hold weights, or raise the back foot on a bench (rear-foot elevated split squat).
split_squat.care: Sharp knee pain at the front: shorten the depth and keep the shin more upright.

mistakes: Rolling the chest forward or back
side_plank.easier: Bend the knees and lift from the knees, not the feet.
side_plank.harder: Lift the top leg, or add a slow hip dip and raise.
side_plank.care: Shoulder pain: switch to the knee version or a standing wall side plank.

mistakes: Rounding the back to reach lower
Opening the hip so the body twists
sl_rdl.easier: Touch a wall or chair with one hand and reach only to the knee.
sl_rdl.harder: Hold a weight in the opposite hand and pause 2 seconds at the bottom.
sl_rdl.care: Fresh hamstring strain: only go as far as feels like a light stretch.

mistakes: Dropping the chest and rounding the back
squat.easier: Sit down to a chair and stand back up (box squat).
squat.harder: Hold a weight at the chest (goblet squat) or slow the lowering to 3 seconds.
squat.care: Knee pain: stop at a pain-free depth; mild discomfort up to 3/10 that settles by morning is OK.

mistakes: Landing with a straight, stiff knee
Bounding far before you can stop each landing
lateral_bound.easier: Small side hops and hold each landing for 2 seconds.
lateral_bound.harder: Bound further and push off straight away into the next jump.
lateral_bound.care: Not yet for early ankle or knee injuries: first pass single-leg balance and hops without pain.

mistakes: Lower back lifting off the floor
dead_bug.easier: Move only the legs, or only the arms.
dead_bug.harder: Straighten the legs further, or hold a light weight in the hands.
dead_bug.care: If the back arches, shorten how far the leg goes out.

mistakes: Bending the knees a lot (it becomes a squat jump)
pogo.easier: Two-leg pogo hops in place, very small.
pogo.harder: Single-leg pogo hops, or forward and side hops.
pogo.care: Achilles or shin pain above 3/10 during or the next morning: go back a stage.

calf_raise.easier: Two feet, holding a wall, on flat floor.
calf_raise.harder: Single-leg calf raise from a step edge, slowly, with a backpack.
calf_raise.care: Achilles pain: slow 3-second lowering usually feels better than fast reps.

mistakes: Forcing the arm to the floor
Turning the neck instead of the upper back
open_book.easier: Open only as far as comfortable with a pillow under the head.
open_book.harder: Hold 3 slow breaths at the end of each turn.
open_book.care: Tingling down the arm: stop and use a smaller range.

mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears
Arching the lower back to lift higher
prone_y.easier: Do it lying on a bench or bed so the arms hang lower.
prone_y.harder: Hold 1 kg weights or pause 3 seconds at the top.
prone_y.care: Pinching pain at the top of the shoulder: lower the arm angle (T instead of Y).

mistakes: Leading with the toes pointed up
hip_abd.easier: Smaller range, bottom knee bent for balance.
hip_abd.harder: Add a band above the knees or a 2-second hold at the top.
hip_abd.care: Pain on the outer hip bone: lie on a softer surface and lower the height.

mistakes: Arching the lower back instead of tucking the pelvis
hip_flexor_stretch.easier: Put a cushion under the knee and keep the range small.
hip_flexor_stretch.harder: Raise the same-side arm overhead and lean gently away.
hip_flexor_stretch.care: Front-of-hip pinch: reduce the lunge depth.

mistakes: Hip dropping on the free-leg side
sl_balance.harder: Eyes closed, a cushion under the foot, or catching a ball.
sl_balance.care: Early ankle sprain: stay near a wall and stop if the ankle gives way.

cat_camel.harder: Hold each end position for 2 breaths.
cat_camel.care: Pain spreading into the leg: use a smaller range and check with a doctor if it keeps spreading.

mistakes: Using a step that is too high
step_up.easier: Low step (10–15 cm), hold a rail.
step_up.harder: Higher step, slow lowering, or carry weights.
step_up.care: Front-of-knee pain: use a lower step and lower slowly.

sl_calf_raise.easier: Two-leg raises, or most weight on the working leg.
sl_calf_raise.harder: From a step edge, or with a backpack.
sl_calf_raise.care: Calf or Achilles pain over 3/10: go back to two legs.

mistakes: Twisting the hips when the leg lifts
Lifting the leg too high so the back arches
bird_dog.easier: Move only the leg, or only the arm.
bird_dog.harder: Hold 5 seconds, or touch elbow to knee under the body between reps.
bird_dog.care: Wrist pain: rest on fists or forearms.

mistakes: Shrugging as the arms go up
Lower back arching off the wall
Forcing the arms to stay on the wall
wall_slide.easier: Stand a small step away from the wall.
wall_slide.harder: Add a light band around the wrists.
wall_slide.care: Shoulder pinch above shoulder height: stop just below it.

plank.easier: Knees on the floor, or hands on a table.
plank.harder: Lift one foot, or reach one arm forward.
plank.care: Low-back pain in the plank: squeeze glutes and shorten the hold.

mistakes: Front foot too close to the bench
bulgarian.easier: Ordinary split squat with the back foot on the floor.
bulgarian.harder: Hold dumbbells and slow the lowering to 3 seconds.
bulgarian.care: Front-of-hip stretch pain in the back leg: lower the bench.

mistakes: Hip on the free side dropping
sl_bridge.easier: Two-leg bridge, or hold the free knee to the chest.
sl_bridge.harder: Foot on a step or bench.
sl_bridge.care: Hamstring cramp: bring the foot closer to the hips.

mistakes: Letting the band turn the body
pallof_press.harder: Step further from the anchor, or stand on one leg.
pallof_press.care: Shoulder pain: keep the hands closer to the chest.

mistakes: Knees going far past the toes
wall_sit.harder: Lower to about 90°, or hold a weight on the thighs.
wall_sit.care: Kneecap pain: go higher. Mild discomfort up to 3/10 is OK.

mistakes: Hip on the free side dropping
step_down.easier: Low step and lightly tap the heel down.
step_down.care: Front-of-knee pain: lower step; stop if pain lasts into the next day.

pushup.easier: Hands on a wall or table, or knees down.
pushup.care: Wrist pain: use push-up handles or fists.

mistakes: Falling the last part with no control
Doing it right after a fresh strain
nordic.easier: Go only part-way down and push back up with the hands.
nordic.care: Expect strong soreness the first times: start with 1–2 sets of 3.

copenhagen.easier: Short lever: support at the knee, not the ankle.
copenhagen.harder: Long lever (ankle on the bench) and lift-and-lower reps.
copenhagen.care: Groin pain over 3/10: shorten the hold or go back to adductor squeezes.

clamshell.harder: Band above the knees, 3-second hold at the top.
clamshell.care: Hip pain at the side: lie on a softer surface.

mistakes: Pushing up on the sore leg
eccentric_heel_drop.easier: Lower on flat floor, not from a step.
eccentric_heel_drop.harder: Add a backpack, then bent-knee lowering too.
eccentric_heel_drop.care: Achilles pain up to 3/10 is OK if it settles by the next morning.
